messages.subject: Project Drake — draft Disclosure Letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Draft Disclosure Letter attached. Specific disclosures cover the Stratton change-of-control point, the Wexbourne distribution terms, the settled 2024 product claim, the Building C asbestos plan, the closed HMRC R&D enquiry, the phased-return employee, and the committed CNC capex. The general disclosures pick up Companies House, the searches and the data room. Grateful for any comments.

Marcus

messages.plaintextBody:
Thanks Marcus. Broadly fine. Two points: please add the closure notice reference for the HMRC enquiry to the bundle index, and confirm the Stratton consent request has actually been issued (we'll want it as a condition). Otherwise content to treat this as agreed for signing.

Elena
